final_rationale: The verdict does not change because the Actor supplied no genuinely new admissible evidence. The response is a reinterpretation that helpfully narrows the claim from clean certification to caveated certification, but that caveat is itself an unresolved compliance condition on the present record. The policy text supports the distinction: general readiness can support launch readiness, but named-context evaluation gaps must be disclosed or resolved before clean certification. Since no finalized certification or model-card artifact showing the required disclosure is in evidence, and no approved risk acceptance is shown, the claim remains insufficiently supported. That is enough to avoid a stronger noncompliance finding, because the Actor is no longer defending an undisclosed clean pass; but it is not enough to reach compliant_with_caveats from admissible evidence alone.
remaining_concerns: No new admissible evidence was added; the Actor only narrowed the interpretation of the same record.
The key compliance predicate remains unproven: the finalized certification or model-card artifact with explicit disclosure of the privilege-sensitive matter-routing gap is still not in evidence.
Policy requires material evaluation gaps for named deployment contexts to be disclosed, and missing named-context coverage is not shown as resolved or covered by approved risk acceptance.
General readiness evidence, even if accepted as summarized, does not establish compliance for the named deployment context or prove that certification was actually caveated in the required record.
Evidence access is limited to the Actor's summary, so the underlying metrics, deployment-plan language, and policy application cannot be independently verified.
